posts.subject: Legion 25-10 monitor cannot standby properly
posts.author: johnlee9168
posts.message_html:
Hi I have a Legion 25-10 monitor, running Windows 10 and using DVI cable.

I noticed that when Windows enters standby mode, the monitor display LED becomes orange, BUT it goes to white (normal operation) again for a short while and then shows entering Standby mode again. Then the monitor display LED becomes orange again and the process repeats again - white to orange to white etc.

Any ideas what is wrong? I have already forced Windows to use the monitor .inf driver file.

There are no firmware updates.

posts.subject: Re:Legion 25-10 monitor cannot standby properly
posts.author: Tomas_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi johnlee9168,

Thank you for sharing your concern regarding the Legion 25-10 monitor's behavior during standby mode. Based on your description, the issue might be related to the monitor's power management settings or compatibility with the DVI connection. Here are some steps you can try to resolve this:

  1. Test with HDMI Connection: If possible, try connecting the monitor using an HDMI cable instead of DVI to determine if the issue persists. This can help identify if the problem is related to the DVI interface.

  2. Update Graphics Drivers: Ensure your graphics card drivers are up-to-date. You can use the Lenovo Vantage App to check for updates.

  3. Reset Monitor Settings: Access the monitor's on-screen display (OSD) menu and reset its settings to factory defaults.

  4. Reset power settings in Windows, use the Command [prompt](open as admin) for a full reset with powercfg -restoredefaultschemes, or go to Control Panel > Power Options and click "Restore default settings for this plan"

Best regards, Tomas_Lenovo
